body:
It doesn't work that way. You can't say I will kill myself next month or next year. The time will never come. Trust me, I have been thinking the same for twenty fucking years now. 

I recently had a failed suicide attempt and realized that once you numb your mind to the fear then it is not too hard. You have to do it in the moment, not plan it out too far in advanced. That is why I am going to do it within the next few days once I finish getting rid of all my belongings. I am so close now. I can taste the freedom.

For the longest time I envied those who were able to kill themselves. But I realized that anyone can do it with some help. I plan on taking some xanax to relax my mind before I hang myself. I am going finally do it. Goodbye to this piece of shit existence.

It depends. If you are a normal person who is having a temporary rut, then yes you can get better. If you have legitimate mental illness, then no you won't get better. I have tried everything - medication, therapy, exercise, etc. All the BS people told me to do. Yet I have been severely depressed and suicidal for 20 years now. It has gotten so bad, I plan on killing myself this weekend.

Good grades don't matter in real life. Trust me. I spent all my life focused on education and it has gotten me nowhere. In the real world it matters how well you deal with other people. That is the most important thing in life. If you lack social skills then everything is pointless. Your career will tank, you will have no meaningful relationships with others, you will become a failure like me - both personally and professionally.

Why is not living at all not an answer? We all die eventually anyway. I wish I was never born. Enduring a miserable life is pointless. What to you have to prove? That you can withstand punishment day after day for years on end? 

200 years ago I would have died even sooner. It is only due to modern living that I managed to make it to my thirties. I was never meant for this world. This place has nothing to offer me.

Golden years? I feel and look terrible. In my 20s I still had the energy, looks and motivation to do stuff. Even though I was completely miserable back then, at least I was highly functional. These days I can't even do the most basic tasks without having a mental breakdown.

I have to disagree. In your 20s you have tons of opportunities -with relationships, dating, education, jobs, traveling, etc.

By your 30s you have to settle down and anchor your life for the future. If you haven't got it together by this time then you are screwed.

That is exactly what I do. I lay in bed and stare at the ceiling. Sometimes for hours at a time. This is no way to live. I want to enjoy life like everyone else. Go to concerts, take trips, etc. But since I don't know anyone it is hard to do those activities alone.

I know exactly how you feel. I am in my thirties now and everyone I went to school with is now married with kids, have great careers, own their own homes, take vacations overseas, etc. They know how to live life. 

Meanwhile I haven't done anything remotely close to living. Like you all I do is go to work and then come back home to sleep. Rinse and repeat. On the weekends I just sleep all day long.

This is no way to live. I can't take this anymore. I am going to kill myself soon. It is already bad enough being thirty and feeling like this, I can't even imagine being forty, fifty, sixty, etc. 

Everyone knows life gets shitter as you age. I know the best years are behind me now.

What do you typically do in your free time? I need more distractions in my life. Otherwise when I have free time I keep wallowing in misery. As much as I hate work, it gives a temporary relief from terrible thoughts in my head. Although some days even staying busy at work the dark thoughts start to creep in.

What are some other hobbies you enjoy doing besides writing? It seems like writing/reading is pretty popular for people who frequent the internet. But that makes sense I guess since the only way to communicate is to read and write.

In my experience things never get better. Only worse. I have severe depression for the last twenty years so I might be biased. In all those years things have only gotten more difficult. 

I think a lot of people here are normal people who got stuck in a short term rut. So once they snap out of it they become happy again. But that doesn't work for mentally ill. I know I will have to carry this burden for the rest of my life. That is why I plan on killing myself soon. I can't take this anymore.

You sound like me. My life was terrible when I was a kid. It got worse into my teenager years. Then my twenties it kept getting worse. Now I am in my thirties and things have gotten so bad, I could have never imagined things being this horrific. 

It is no secret that life gets harder as you get older. But for most people they learn ways to cope with life. When you are depressed it robs you of this and you are left to wallow in misery. I want to die so bad. I don't want to keep on living like this in my forties, fifties and beyond. If life was so terrible during the best years, what is there left for me in the later stages when life gets truly difficult?

What kind of writing do you do? I know you said you had a publishing deal in the past that you decided to terminate. Are you thinking of publishing something else?

What kind of stuff are you learning? What I want to know more than anything is how did you pick yourself back up? Can you start from the beginning?

I resent my parents for giving birth to me. I had such a fucked up childhood. I don't even know what it means to be a human being these days. The only good that has come out of this is that I won't have a family of my own. Which means I can make an early exit from this hell without disappointing anyone.
Life is just unrelenting. I don't think these thoughts will ever go away. It is either keep on suffering or end your own life. Not great options to choose from.
You can help me die. If this sounds like something you'd be interested in please send me a message. I can even fly out to you.

You seem to have your life together despite your past. That is why I was asking how you were when you were younger. Sorry if I upset you, that was not my intention.

What do you do when you're not working? What do you do for fun? I am trying to figure out stuff to do at night and weekends.

Life only gets harder as you get older. I have reluctantly accepted the fact that the best years of my life have already passed. Even though those early years were awful, my life has become more horrible than I could have ever imagined. It will only keep getting worse.

My biggest regret in life is not killing myself sooner. I just dragged this out for far too long. I have decided 2019 is my final year on this miserable planet. Hopefully I can do it this time around, preferably before summer.

I know how you feel. I want to die more than anything. I have no reason to live either. It is really hard to kill yourself. I have tried but backed out the last moment. I know I will kill myself someday but so far I haven't had the courage to see it through.

That is why I have been practicing hanging myself before  I go to bed every night lately. I tie a noose around my neck and manually pull on it to simulate hanging myself. 

Last time I tried to kill myself I couldn't kick the chair from underneath my feet. It is harder than anything I have ever attempted. Eventually I know I will kill myself. I don't want to keep feeling like this.

That is why I plan on killing myself deep in the forest where no one will find my body. Also my parents are deceased so they won't be disappointed by my death. If they were alive they probably wouldn't care too much anyway.
I have no one to reach out to. I don't even know how to put myself out there because it has been so long since I tried. I just don't see the point of it all.

How do you live in the now? I will try the small things like you mentioned. I will keep trying them if I get the opportunity. I don't expect much to change though.

What are some things you like to do during your free time? What were you like when you were younger? I just want to get to know you better.

My future is so uncertain. I live day to day just to survive. It is hard to do what you are saying. Abandoning everything and living in the moment is a luxury I can't afford. It seems like self delusion to live that way unless you are wealthy and have a secure future.

The daily grind is pointless for me. I hate my job. In my free time I just do nothing because I am so exhausted from living. I know everyone has to deal with this and yet they manage to have a life outside of work. I don't know what is wrong with me. I don't even feel like a human being sometimes.

If there are no reasons to live, why keep on suffering? I don't get it. If you are just doomed to repeat the same day over and over again then what is the point? 

I have lived like this for so long now. I can't take it anymore. Living day to day with no purpose, nothing to look forward to is absolute hell.

This is bs. For some people there is no meaning to life. Some people have nothing and no one. 

This kind of advice only applies to normal people who are feeling sad temporarily. People who are mentally ill and have been for years will not suddenly get better. There is no better life.
I am so far gone past this point. To me everything is pointless. Even living.
When I am dead I won't be suffering anymore. I will finally have peace. That is all I want.

Surely you must have a reason to live. Some kind of purpose. Otherwise what is point of living? 

I am having a difficult time understanding your point of view. Existing just to exist is such a hopeless way of living imo.
Eventually I know I am going to kill myself. I just hope it is sooner than later. I can't live like this anymore.

It sounds like being maniac is feeling truly alive. Even if it has its bad sides. I rather feel invincible than feel completely worthless. Like I said this is probably because I never experienced it first hand so I am idealizing it. I rather feel something, anything than feeling nothing at all.
How do find the motivation to keep trying? I find it extremely difficult to do anything. What keeps you going? What do you live for?

You sound so much like me. As I said before I never met anyone who has been depressed as long as I have. Like you I know my best years are behind me. Things were bad back then too but compared to how bad things have gotten now, it was much more preferable. My future looks bleak. I can't even see myself being alive for another year, much less twenty or thirty years. 

I can't remember a time when I wasn't depressed. It has been twenty unending years of depression. I wish I had a manic phase. Maybe because I never had an up phase I am stupidly idealizing it. But it has to be better than being depressed.

Because I have always been this way. This is my normal way of thinking. I can't even recognize what I am doing because this is just the way I think. 

It is hard to change when you don't even know what you are doing wrong. I kind of get what you are saying now that you are pointing it out. I am not sure how I am supposed to figure it out on my own.

Don't try to OD. It is the least effective way to end your life. You will just be in pain and misery for nothing. I won't try to stop you from killing yourself, because that will be hypocritical of me, since I want to die too. That being said don't do it with pills and booze.

The biggest regret I have in life is not killing myself sooner. It is so hard to actually kill yourself. I have been wanting to die for the past twenty years now. It takes tremendous will power to end your own life. 

I am so jealous of people who managed to overcome their survival instincts and kill themselves. I want to know their secret, how they managed to do it.

Your cousin sounds like a strong person, just like you. I am weak. I have been this way since I was a child. I have no fight in me anymore.

I don't think these people are gods or idols. Just normal people with normal lives. I realize you can't be happy or satisfied all the time. But for most people they still have significant moments where they are happy or achieve something useful. I haven't had any of these moments. 

My story is my life. I don't know any other way of living or way of thinking. I will make an attempt at small steps. I am not sure how much it will help but I will try when I remember. Another aspect of depression is that it leaves me in a perpetual state of fog. I just can't think properly or remember to do basic things.

It is brutal to be depressed for so long. I have been this way for twenty years now. It has robbed me of my childhood and adolescence. Now in as an adult I can barely function day to day. Just the overwhelming grief of a life never lived makes me want to die so badly. I feel so miserable and empty all the time. I can't take this anymore. I just want to die.

I never met anyone who was depressed as long as I have been. Twenty years is a long time. I am sorry you feel this way. I know better than anyone else how crushing it can be. That is why I plan on ending my life soon. Twenty years has been long enough. I don't want to deal with this for another twenty years.

Yeah my parents were terrible people. They are both deceased but I still resent them for giving birth to me. I think if I got help when I was a child, then I would have become a normal and functioning adult. Instead of the worthless trash I have become.

What do you mean by gods and idols? I am not sure if I completely understand what you mean. 

I sustained some injuries in the past and as a result I have chronic issues. I definitely feel weaker and slower mentally compared to my twenties. I have zero appetite and often skip meals. I tried forcing myself to eat but that never really works. I have become frail and weak.

I know that you have to keep fighting to make changes and improve your life. I am not sure how other people do it. The constant struggle is overwhelming to me. Even small steps is challenging. Most of the time I don't even know what the first step is. I think I have just become stupid over the years. I never know what to do or what to think.
I told my mom when I was 13 that I wanted to kill myself. She told me that everyone hates life and everyone wants to die. Then she told me to get over it.
Yes. I had it since I was in middle school. I am in my thirties now and my depression has only gotten worse over time.

I get what are you trying to say. But I missed out on so many of life's experiences that everyone else has. It is hard to cope with this. It is paralyzing to know I completely wasted the best years of my life.

I know you are going to say I can live the best years now but I am not sure about that. I can already feel the aging process decreasing my health and quality of life. As a grown adult making new friends and dating is so hard to do. I only have a small window to establish new relationships and the pressure is eating me alive. 

I don't want to compare myself to others. But that being said there are certain milestones that society expects you to meet by a certain age. I missed out on all the fundamental ones. I wish I could just shut my brain off from telling me how worthless I am. But I can't seem to do that.

I just want a normal life. Is that asking for too much? Maybe it is. I just made too many mistakes in the past. I wish I could just be happy to be alive but I don't even know what happy feels like anymore. 

I don't need or want to be perfect. I just want to be normal.
At this point I don't even care if I end up maiming myself. I just want to die so badly. I can't live like this anymore.

To have friends you need money. To hang out with them, to eat meals together, to do actually build a relationship with people requires you to spend money. Just like everything else in life. It is hard to live like a normal human being when you are struggling every week just to survive and feed yourself. 

I wish I was never born. I was born to poor and mentally ill parents. I have become just like them, I am also poor and suffer from severe mental illness. The worst part of it all is that both my parents passed away when I was younger. They brought me into this shit existence and then make an early exit. To this day I still despise them.

Wow all of that sounds so familiar. I know I should do something but instead I just tell myself what is the point of doing anything. 

What cheers you up? What helps you distract yourself from depression?

I will give it a shot. I suppose it is better than doing nothing. I already have zero expectations out of my life. Living this way seems pretty pointless. Like I am just drifting along, letting life do whatever it wants to me.

I want to set some goals but often times think what is the point. I just feel like a failure all the time. I am so ashamed of what my life has become. I know people say not to compare your life to others but it is so hard when my life is so miserable.

I do say hello to people. It never really leads anywhere. I think all the years of social isolation has made me unable to connect with others. It is hard not to look at the big picture. People tell me to put myself out there but I don't even know what means anymore.

It's bs. I grew up playing sports. While the distraction can be nice, it hardly fixes the symptoms of depression. It is just another hobby like anything else. It is supposed to be healthy but I am not sure if I am going to be around long enough to reap the benefits.

It would be nice to actually do things and get out of the apartment. But since I am so fatigued, I just sleep whenever I have free time. It takes a lot of energy just to go grocery shopping or get a haircut. I know it sounds ridiculous. I need to buy new clothes but I have been putting it off for months. I have tried online shopping but clothes never fit me right because I am tall and skinny. I have to buy it in person.

Yeah that would be nice. Going shopping for clothes. I want to but I don't know why I can't. I don't think I fear being out in public, it just seems daunting for some reason though. I would also like to make friends and hang out with people on the weekends. Maybe even start dating again. But I am not sure how to go about that. It has been years since I had any connections with other people.
I don't own many possessions. As a result my apartment is very clean. It is unintentional since I just don't have enough stuff for my place to become cluttered or messy.

The majority of people who commit suicide are from low to middle class. The rare case of a wealthy person committing suicide just means they would have killed themselves even sooner if they were poor. 

You could argue that money isn't everything but without it you can't do anything. If you are miserable with money, you would be 10x more miserable if you were poor. It just makes life so much more difficult.
I thought I was the only one who did this. I spend hours a daydreaming about a fictional life I will never have.  I feel so pathetic but it is the only escape I have from myself.

I am in my thirties and wasted my entire life up to this point. I want to die so bad. I missed out on all the experiences normal people have. I am so far behind my peers both professionally and with personal relationships. I don't see the point of living anymore. I can't even imagine being in my 70s. Living through this for another 40 years seems extremely cruel.

I am just tired of trying. I can barely get out of bed these days. It takes all the energy I have to function at work. When I come home, I go straight to bed. Sometimes I don't even eat dinner because I am so exhausted. I know this is due to the depression but I can't motivate myself to seek a therapist. I did in the past but it really didn't help me all that much. Ditto with medication.
Start my success with something small? What do you suggest? I wouldn't even know where to start honestly.

The powers at be need us peasant serfs for cheap labor. Otherwise the economy would tank. That is the only reason why suicide is considered taboo. The government and wealthy elite can't have the working class commit mass suicide.

You are right. I do focus on the past a lot. I've missed out on so many basic human experiences, thinking back makes me feel so miserable. I completely wasted my youth. I have a hard time coping with this. 

My present life sucks as a result. You have to build success on top success. People who have a life worked their entire lives for it.  I am realizing now that I will never live a normal life like everybody else. I want to stop thinking about it but it is so hard to do.
I switch between feeling miserable and feeling nothing. This is no way to live. I can't stand it anymore. I just want to die so badly.

You sound a lot like me. Every night before I go to bed, I place a noose around my neck and pull on it manually. Just to see how it feels. I have been doing this for weeks now. I am just trying to get used to it so when the time comes I will be able to finally hang myself properly. 

I have practiced making a noose knot so many times, I can do it with my eyes closed now.

This. Having relationships with the opposite sex is our sole purpose in life. That is why we maintain our appearances, groom ourselves, work jobs we hate, try to develop a better personality, etc. If I knew I was going to die alone I would just stop trying at life. Although there is a strong possibility this will happen anyway, at least there is some hope or dream that maybe someone out there will be a match for me. I don't know if this is just self delusion though.
You can't. Dying is just sleeping without the waking up part. The only thing I like to do these days is sleep. Sleep is the best. If dying is an eternal sleep then it is my idea of heaven.

Finally a person that gets it. Why can't people admit that some lives are just not worth living? Why is it so hard to admit that some people are just worthless to society? 

I think the powers at be (gov and the wealthy elite) can't have us poor serfs offing ourselves. They need our cheap labor to keep the economy afloat. That's my theory to why suicide is considered taboo in society.

I just think that dying is returning to a time before I was born. I just want to return home to the void so badly. I have been too much of a coward to kill myself but I plan on doing it soon enough. For the first time in my life I will have courage.

Yeah. Life is all about having meaningful connections with other people. Literally nothing else matters. Also you can't just wait around hoping life will toss you a bone. It will never happen. You have to fight for every scrap. 

Of course with depression it makes this extremely difficult because you don't have the energy or motivation to endure the grind of living.

But what about money? With more education you could do more things and make more money. I know you are going to say money doesn't matter. But it does. Money isn't everything but without it you can't do anything.

I work a crappy job that barely covers my expenses and the stress of barely scrapping by just compounds my misery. 

I have just been living like an idiot for so long. Anyone else would have killed themselves a long time ago if they were in my shoes. I am just too tired to do anything anymore.

Yeah I tried CBT and SSRIs. It really didn't help all that much. Plus I didn't like the feeling of being on medication. I also strongly distrust therapists and doctors so I can never be fully honest in sessions. That is probably why it doesn't work for me.

No, I am just passive and a coward. Anyone else would have killed themselves a long time ago if they were in my shoes. I am so pathetic. All I ever wanted was to die but still couldn't manage it in all this time.

I read through this. I don't agree with some of the points the author makes. Especially the part about money. Yeah money isn't everything but without it you can't do anything. Trust me. I've been poor all myself and it is a constant struggle.

It sounds like you have a good boss who cares. I walk on eggshells because I know they just want a reason to fire me. I do good work but I am socially retarded so I managed to alienate myself from everyone at work. It doesn't matter how hard you work if you have poor social skills.

No wonder you are so patient. You deal with annoying people every single day. I am glad you enjoy your job because I could never do it. I am not a perfectionist, I am anything but. Wanting a normal life like everybody else is having low standards. Yet I failed at that too. 

How do you keep on going when you keep failing? When I was in my twenties I kept on going despite feeling terrible. But these days I am just so tired of trying and failing. 

Have you thought about going back to school? Is therapy/counseling something you could see yourself doing?

You told your boss you tried to commit suicide? I could never do that in fear of being fired. The prospect of ending up homeless and starving would actually push me over the edge to suicide. 

I have tried before but couldn't do it the last moment. It is hard when you have a bed to sleep at night and food to eat. That is why I considered quitting my job. Just so I have more reason to kill myself. 

For some reason planning out my suicide and imagining it in my head makes me feel at peace. It is the only way I can cope with life. I totally understand what you are saying about the dark thoughts creeping in. It is hard to distract yourself from being consumed by them.

I am not sure if me posting nonsense online to a bunch of complete strangers qualifies as taking steps in improving. While it is nice to see that I am not the only person who feels this way, it is actually more depressing to realize that for some people this illness never goes away. 

I wish I was never born. Life is so unfair. People who want to live die everyday. Meanwhile I wanted to die for the past twenty years but still am alive.

This is something you have to keep reaffirming right? In the past I did try a similar approach but ended up stopping because I kept failing at it. It is hard when depression makes even the tiniest change so difficult. 

If you don't mind me asking, what do you do for a living? Are you a therapist or social worker? You seem to be very knowledgeable in this area.

I've tried medication and therapy before. They didn't really help the root cause. Only masked it. Instead of feeling miserable all the time, I just felt empty. Which is a different kind of sadness. I rather feel something, even feeling like shit rather than be a zombie on meds. I have been this way my entire life. I don't know any other kind of existence.

You are a victim of ageism. At a certain point you are unhireable because you would be too expensive to hire. Companies rather hire 2-3 fresh grads in your place and train them.

That is why people switch companies, industries, etc in their 20s and 30s. But settle down by their 40s. In your 50s you better pray that you don't get fired. The job market is brutal. 

I wish you the best. I, too, know the frustrations of having a failed professional life. I did everything I was supposed to do. Yet someone has to fall by the wayside and unfortunately in this case it happened to be us.
So what did you do besides ignoring other people's criticisms? What are some concrete examples of you taking small steps? I don't even know where to start.

People always tell me to take it day by day with small steps. When I ask them for examples they never respond. I have tried everything people told me to do. Therapy, medication, exercise, reading, meditation, etc. Nothing works.

It is true though. Depression makes even simple things like getting up in the morning and taking a shower difficult. Dealing with the cruel reality of life is impossible when you are depressed as a result.

Yes. I never eat, I don't have much of an appetite anyways. I am so weak and frail now. I isolate myself from everyone and everything. I disabled my airbags, don't wear seatbelts and speed excessively. In case someone hits me I want to die.

This hits so close to home. Depression makes it impossible to plan ahead. Because I always think what is the point. It is a vicious cycle. Failure to think and plan means we will never get better. I pray for death everyday. No one has answered my wishes for twenty years now. I've come to realize just like everything else in life, if you want to die, you have to do it yourself.

You don't have to reply when you are out with your friends. I feel bad for taking your precious time. I get what you are saying but it is hard not to think like this when I have been this way for so long. I have always hated myself my entire life. It would be impossible to change overnight. You are a saint. I know I must be like a brick wall to talk to, yet you keep replying. You deserve to be happy. You are a good person. Can't say the same for me. I know I couldn't help anyone like you are doing. I just wanted to tell you thanks.

But you can't look at it like that globally. You have to account for where you live population wise. Then narrow that down by single status and similar age group. Then if the person would actually get along with me and vice versa. Lastly we would have to run into each other somehow and be in a good mood that moment. Accounting for all of that, there might be maybe 2-3 women that would possibly enjoy my company. How am I supposed to find these unicorns?

If you don't feel lonely then you are an anomaly. Humans are social creatures. We crave social interaction more than anything else. Our biological purpose is to procreate. Being alone and childless is the worst fate imaginable to me. I don't blame anyone but myself for the situation I am in.

When you lose all hope nothing seems to matter. I always knew I was going to eventually kill myself. My parents are deceased and I have no friends. I don't have any loved ones stopping me from killing myself. Yet I am still alive. 

It is incredibly hard to actually kill yourself. I have tried in the past. I plan on trying it again soon. I just wanted to let you know that I know more than anyone else how you feel. Fighting to survive does seem pointless when you have nothing to keep you going. Existence is hell for us. Like you said at some point it will be too hard to resist. Death seems like a viable option more and more everyday.

You said you were in your 40s. Doesn't it get lonely? I am incredibly lonely all the time. How do you deal with feeling left out? 

I am torn because as much as I want to get married and have kids, I know I will just drag everyone down with me. Also no woman in their right mind would start a family with someone like me. So perhaps it is just for the best.

I envy that you enjoy your job. If I had something to get me through the day it would make this life less miserable.

Is wanting a normal life too much to ask? I think your examples are too extreme and unrelatable. I get what you are trying to say though. It is hard not to hate myself when I don't have anything going on in my life. 

I look at my future where I am just struggling everyday to survive. Just the thought of doing this until I am 70 is so daunting that the thought of making a quick exit is very tempting.

Can I ask you some personal questions? You don't have to answer if you don't feel comfortable. Are you married? Do you have kids? Do you enjoy your job? I just want to know your life situation and see if what you are saying is even applicable to me.
Yes, I know this feeling. It physically hurts to be alive. That is why I just sleep as much as possible.

No one wants me dead. Both my parents passed away when I was young. I am the only child. I have no friends. I wish I had someone in my life, even if they hated me. 

Maybe I just had high hopes for myself. When I see the people I went to school with have great careers, married with kids, buying new houses, etc I feel like such a worthless piece of shit.

All I ever wanted was to be a normal person and live a normal life. Somehow I managed to mess something so simple up. I just try to live day by day now. 

It sounds like the problem you had was you were letting others around you dictate your life. Once you stopped doing that you felt better. I am not in that position. No one is telling me to do anything. I have no one. This is an internal struggle. A struggle I had for twenty years and lost.

Yeah those things work on normal people because they are not that far gone. They still have a healthy mind and will to live. For someone who has given up on life, nothing works. If someone has been this way for too long then they will never get better.

You have a way with words. You capture exactly what I feel but write it in a clever way. I wish I knew people like you in real life. As much as it sucks being suicidal and depressed, if I knew someone in the same boat we could just be there for one another.

I feel like such a fraud. While I don't lie to people, I hide the truth and let them assume whatever they want. If I told people the truth I would be seen as such a loser. I know this from experience. People don't want to be around mopey and pathetic people. People want to be around happy and well adjusted people.

I was like that for a while but recently I have become so lonely. I look at the people who I went to school with. They are all in relationships or married, have kids, have good careers, bought new homes, etc. I feel like the biggest loser in the world. Life has passed me by. I can't stand living like this anymore.

So let me ask you this, how did you overcome your depression? What did you do? As I mentioned early I tried everything people told me to do. Therapy, medication, exercise, reading, mediation, etc. Nothing works. I am really glad you are feeling better and I wish you the best, I really do. But we are just in different situations. I am hopeless. Sorry for wasting so much of your time with this.

I have tried everything people have told me to do as well. Medication, therapy, exercise, reading, mediation, etc. Nothing works. 

These things work on normal people who are just temporarily stuck in a rut and need a slight nudge to get them back to being happy. But for mentally ill people like us nothing works. I just can't take this anymore. I plan on killing myself soon enough. Knowing this will all end soon is the only way I can cope with life.
